text:
maria: seeing a ~6-8% spike in 504s from hosted-api edge in us-west-2 since 09:03. Customers report streaming timeouts and failed completions. example request-id: rq_0a1b2c3d

sam: can you attach a curl repro and one or two trace ids? also, which customer/account?

maria: repro (works consistently when we add X-Account-Id header):
```
curl -v "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "X-Account-Id: acct-42" \
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'
```

trace: 2026-03-17T09:04:12Z rq_0a1b2c3d

jonathan: envoy shows upstream response timeout and h2 connection drain on the billing-proxy pool:
```
[2026-03-17T09:04:12.123Z] upstream request timeout: upstream:10.43.5.12:8080, code: 504, route: /billing/resolve
[...snip...]
```

lee: customer says the error only happens when the request includes X-Account-Id (guest flows without header are fine). suspicious that billing-resolver is getting hot for certain account IDs and blocking the auth path.

infra-bot: Alert: hosted-api.edge.us-west-2 - 504 rate +430% over 5m (rule=edge.gateway.504.spike)

ashley: can reproduce locally by hammering billing-resolver with account=acct-42; backend tail latency climbs and then envoy returns 504s. possible thundering herd on cache miss.

sam: quick repro attempt returned 504 as well; response body from edge:
```
HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Timeout
content-type: application/json
{"error":"upstream timeout","request_id":"rq_0a1b2c3d"}
```

maria: temporary mitigation suggestion: mask X-Account-Id at edge for suspicious routes to force cached-account fallback, and kick billing-resolver to a canary pool. pushing an ingress rule change would be fast.

jonathan: I'll push a canary config to route billing-resolver->billing-resolver-canary and add a header-mask rule for X-Account-Id on the /v1/generate route. command I'm using:
```
redwoodctl routes set --route /v1/generate --header-mask X-Account-Id --canary billing-resolver-canary
```

sam: good. if 504s drop, we'll keep canary and open a ticket for billing service scaling + account-rate-limiting. add incident label and notify CS to update affected customers.

maria: added incident label and pinged CS. thanks :thumbsup:
